scope: All 18 QA-only additions and their actual current application, store, selector, observer, owned-profile and terminal-harness callers. Source checkpoint only; no campaign execution or completion claim.

findings.title: Exact Continue locator omits the shipped accessible-name suffix
findings.evidence: The actual result button in app/page.tsx:1294-1296 has visible text Continue to Mission N followed by a space and ↗. proveVictory uses exact:true without the suffix, as does the shared button() invoked by continueMission. Existing accepted callers use exact:false or a matching regular expression. The first victory waits 60 seconds and fails, and the transition click independently cannot match.
findings.requiredRepair: Use a single source-linked matcher for the actual ordinary Continue control in both proof and click. Test the actual matcher against the current UI name, including its suffix, rather than stubbing button().

findings.title: Named effect waits are rejected before their supported objective observer
findings.evidence: Executing the frozen actual progressFor body with either effect-present or effect-finished and kind:bridge, no artificial actor ID, throws Wait must name its objective. observation.mjs:394-395 already scopes these objectives to effects of the named kind. Both early routes need bridge lifecycle observations; the active wait initializes progress before checking condition completion.
findings.requiredRepair: Recognize a validated named effect kind as an objective and route it to the existing effect-only progress observer. Prove unrelated effects, actors and clocks cannot renew the deadline; exercise the actual adapter.

findings.title: Failed predecessor admission also accepts a terminal server-cleanup failure
findings.evidence: The unchanged harness at scripts/local-render/harness.mjs:200 overwrites outcome with failed/failure/previousFailure when stopServer throws, but leaves browser-derived cleanupVerified true and subsequently writes that flag to the profile. The current validator admits this actual terminal shape and merely appends prior-harness-failure. Thus unknown server cleanup can be reused as a campaign segment, contrary to the required restriction to a completed boundary with known cleanup and retained earlier helper failures.
findings.requiredRepair: Bind the deliberately emitted boundary terminal outcome/error to the boundary record and require the actual terminal envelope to match it. Reject later cleanup, readback, runtime or source overrides while retaining a genuine completed boundary whose earlier helper failures were carried honestly. No application/harness change is necessary.

independentFocused.source: The frozen candidate was clean and HEAD/app tree were rechecked after this independent run; retained raw source-bound worker receipts are verified above.

positiveBoundaries: Scenario import rejects launchEnabled=false before the maintained CLI acquires a profile or launches a server/browser.
Fresh startup uses Select Mission 1 and Start Mission 1. No All missions bypass, model command execution, storage fabrication, old-profile adoption or copied historical framework was introduced.
Continue installs replacement observation before the ordinary input, requires same store/new World/new scene/current correspondence, closes the old observer and creates a level-tagged epoch.

Save/readback/Load are sequential ordinary UI paths. Load captures the replacement synchronously, uses Pause before diagnostic imports, and distinguishes loaded actor/terrain/stock projections from full committed-record identity.
The reused passive observer chains application callbacks once, preserves original exceptions, and keeps diagnostics separate. Placement/spell legality and movement context use detached clones.

Mission marks are level-scoped and ordered; arbitrary marks cannot satisfy Save/Load, victory or protected M3 evidence. Active epochs add across Load and mission boundaries; proposed active and wall caps are finite.

Queued preserving stops are checked in active waits and UI polling and are deferred only through the already-issued Save readback. Unknown or altered input terminates with preservation intent. No failure-triggered fallback Save exists.
limitations: Passing source tests establish neither playable runtime flow nor completed campaigns. R1 shows the existing stubbed flow test was insufficient. Standard check/build, actual fresh campaign, native parity, calibrated presentation and hardware performance remain unproved. Original M3 profile and quarantined node_modules925630 were not accessed. No production or harness files were edited.
